newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sommer declines comment on Armstrong move.
newsitem.headline: Sommer declines comment on Armstrong move.

text.p: Sommer Allibert declined comment on Thursday on Armstrong World Industries Inc's move to cut the percentage of Domco stock required to be tendered to get around Sommer's opposition to its takeover bid for Domco.
Sommer Allibert, which owns 57.1 percent of the Canadian company, had agreed to merge its floor-covering activities -- including Domco -- with those of Germany's Tarkett.

Pennsylvania-based Armstrong on Wednesday cut the percentage needed to be tendered in its C$23 a share bid to 51 percent on a fully diluted basis from 66-2/3 percent. It said Domco's board has the right to issue shares without shareholder approval.
Armstrong also extended its tender offer to August 15 from July 14.
